ROOT.proceduredef: CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.WMRPotomne(@ID INT) AS BEGIN DECLARE @c int CREATE TABLE #potomne (WMR_ID INT UNIQUE) INSERT INTO #potomne SELECT A.WMR_ID FROM cdn.Wymiary AS A join cdn.Wymiary AS B ON B.Wmr_Id=A.Wmr_ParId AND B.Wmr_ID=@ID SET @c=0 WHILE @c<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #potomne) BEGIN SET @c=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #potomne) insert into #potomne select A.Wmr_ID from cdn.Wymiary as A join cdn.Wymiary as B ON B.Wmr_Id=A.Wmr_ParId JOIN #potomne ON B.Wmr_ID=#potomne.Wmr_ID AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #potomne WHERE #potomne.Wmr_ID=A.Wmr_ID) END SELECT Wmr_ID FROM #potomne DROP TABLE #potomne END
